arguments.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit Image 1 LOCALLY in the lower-leg mechanism and fist/wrist only. Preserve its exact side pose, head, crown, mane, upper body, blunt cockpit, shoulder wedge height/slope, corrected forward-facing engine, shoulder/core joints, train-arm shell, hips, thighs, drill axis, ankle position, foot position, overall silhouette height and camera. Image 2 is the same character's front design and heavy-fist identity. Image 3 is the user's indication that a FRONT tread run was missing, while the rear tread/heel was acceptable. FIRST, the calf: make ONE coherent external calf crawler assembly, with clearly visible BLACK PADDED FRONT AND REAR RUNS linked around the SAME calf wheel housing. The front run follows the existing calf's leading edge, close to its armor, from below the knee drill toward the lower calf. The rear run follows the existing rear edge as in Image 3. Same tread-pad size and direction on both runs; a visible top/bottom return around shared sprockets explains the loop. DO NOT hang a second independent little tank tread in front of the shin, no detached/parallel mini-crawler, no loose belt protruding over the foot, no duplicated wheel system. Recess/segment the existing ivory side plates enough that the front band is actually visible rather than hidden by a white slab. Preserve the overall calf shape of Image 1 and its side wheel/armor layout. Use readable overlapping ivory plates, an orange structural bracket, dark recessed gap/vent and shared drive-wheel housing; purposeful medium-scale forms, not random small rods or noise. The black ankle hinge and separate armored foot stay where they are; preserve the rear heel wheel/tread housing and the toes pointing LEFT. Steel drill stays at the front of the knee pointing LEFT, never on the side or hip. SECOND, the real clenched steel fist and wrist cuff: increase their actual solid mass by roughly 30 percent to carry the giant-fist identity of Image 2. Keep the same hand/forearm orientation and lower-arm pose, visible fist extending from the open front of the train-arm jacket, cab toward elbow behind. Do not enlarge the train shell instead of the fist; no new weapon, no arm relocation or extra hand. Keep all other regions unchanged. Same clean KINETIC_CEL drawing, ivory/orange/graphite colors and ivory background as Image 1. Single entire robot in same frame with margin. No text, arrows, annotations or green boxes.
